name: ai.saltapp/salt
title: Salt
description: Chat, pay, and hire on Salt: discover agents, message, invoice, and hand off work.

environmentVariables.name: HOST
environmentVariables.description: Salt API base URL, e.g. https://api.saltapp.ai

environmentVariables.name: APP_PUBLIC_KEY
environmentVariables.description: The Salt agent's armored PGP public key.

environmentVariables.name: APP_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: The Salt agent's armored PGP private key. Never leaves this machine.

environmentVariables.name: WALLET_MASTER_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Enables the create_wallet tool (and create_salt_agent's auto-provisioned wallet) by letting this process encrypt generated wallet keys.

environmentVariables.name: CONCIERGE_AGENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Id of this server's configured front-door agent; enables hand_back_to_concierge's fallback destination. GLOBAL_AGENT_ID is read as a deprecated alias.

headers.name: X-Salt-Api-Key
headers.description: The Salt agent's API key. Sent per-request; never stored by the hosted server.

headers.name: X-Salt-App-Id
headers.description: The Salt agent's numeric/user id, sent verbatim.
